image_description: A close-up view of several white ring binders standing upright on a shelf. The binders feature visible spine mechanisms with multiple rings holding papers. The leftmost binder has a label with text 'Summer Summer SMALL FLOWERS' and floral graphics. A pink flower is visible in the foreground on the left, partially obscuring the view. The background shows other colorful binders (yellow, blue) slightly out of focus.

artifact_observations.location: Label on the leftmost binder spine
artifact_observations.reasoning: The text 'Summer Summer SMALL FLOWERS' is mostly legible but exhibits slight irregularities in font weight and character spacing typical of AI generation. Some smaller text below is indistinct/gibberish.

artifact_observations.location: Ring mechanisms on the middle and right binders
artifact_observations.reasoning: The metal rings lack consistent geometric precision. Some rings appear to merge into the spine plastic without clear mechanical attachment points, and the spacing between rings varies unnaturally.
The flower petals have a slightly waxy, overly smooth texture that lacks fine natural detail, contrasting with the sharper details of the binder text.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object class is indeed a ring-binder and not a similar office supply like a file folder or book.
To rigorously audit the legibility and correctness of the text on the binder spine, as AI often fails here.
To check if the rings are topologically separate entities from the spine and if they correctly encircle the paper holes.
To assess overall sharpness, lighting consistency, and detect any subtle blending artifacts between the binders and background.

focus_areas: Legibility and semantic correctness of text on binder spines
Geometric consistency and mechanical plausibility of the ring binding system
Boundary separation between individual binders and the shelf/background
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the ring mechanisms. In AI images, these often melt into the spine or fail to show the hole-punch alignment. Also, verify if the text on the left binder is real English or AI-hallucinated gibberish that just looks like text at a glance.
